arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo, replace

# Test R2: Iteration
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
print('R2 - Iteration:', list(v))

# Test R3: Comparison with tuple
print('R3 - Compare with tuple (eq):', v == (1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build'))
print('R3 - Compare with tuple (lt):', v < (2, 0, 0, None, None))
print('R3 - Compare with string (should be NotImplemented/False):', v == '1.2.3')

# Test R4: Bump methods
print('R4 - bump_major:', v.bump_major())
print('R4 - bump_minor:', v.bump_minor())
print('R4 - bump_patch:', v.bump_patch())
print('R4 - bump_prerelease:', v.bump_prerelease())
print('R4 - bump_build:', v.bump_build())

# Test R5: Type conversion
v2 = VersionInfo('1', '2', '3', 123, 456)
print('R5 - Types:', type(v2.major), type(v2.prerelease), type(v2.build))

# Test R7: Replace function and method
print('R7 - Module replace:', replace('1.2.3', minor=5))
print('R7 - Method replace:', v.replace(minor=5))
"

raw_message.reasoning: All tests pass. Now let me test my new features manually to make sure they work correctly.
